description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON assessments feed (batch bundle): 2 QuestionnaireResponse resources — qr-1 a PHQ-9 the member answered themselves (source === subject, patient-reported) and qr-2 a fall-risk screen a clinician recorded (source !== subject, clinician-recorded) — each identity-anchored via the seam, plus 1 malformed response missing the questionnaire canonical (quarantine). Answers are coded items + integer scores only; no free-text narrative. No member names; subjects are source ids anchored through the identity seam.
